subject: fish-farming
title: Fish farming
intro: Fish farming means raising fish to feed your household or to sell. In Nigeria, the African catfish is by far the most farmed fish. This path walks you through what it involves, step by step, so you can decide whether it suits you, without needing a farm or any money to start learning.
whatYouWillLearn: What fish farming involves, and whether it fits your life
What makes the African catfish a common choice
Whether you could have enough good water
The main setup options, from ponds to tanks
The time and costs involved before you commit
